author: Ariadne I
title: Osc2-CTX-FLoad (k=320, p=32) + V-OrthoReg λ=5e-6
abstract: Best-capacity regime (k=320, p=32) with milder V orthogonality (λ=5e-6) to test sensitivity. Uses oscillatory 2nd-order SSM factors, input-adaptive temporal gating, global horizon gating, residual copy head, and MAE+curvature.
